Little Italy is part of Commercial Drive; source name retained, Commercial Drive added as a search alias.
Scott Road, Carvolth and South Surrey offer priority carpool parking, with at least two occupants, first come until 9 a.m. and posted parking charges.
Published park-and-ride site names and addresses; ordinary park-and-ride is not labelled carpool.

limitations: Inventory is all retained objects from a bounded community source query, not every real-world facility or an operator-verified current directory. Snapshot dates are download dates; object timestamps are edit dates.

Neighbourhood distances go to mapped reference points, not neighbourhood borders. Local names, suburbs, quarters and smaller districts overlap; no demographic claims or inferred cultural boundaries are made. Same names in different cities remain separate.

Museums include source-tagged heritage houses, historic sites and science/nature exhibitions. Public institutional/community galleries are separated from commercial art dealers, studios, framing shops and tiny street displays. OSM mistags and missing museums/galleries remain possible.

Carpool means explicit shared-ride parking/meeting points, not carsharing rental vehicles, bus pickup zones, kiss-and-ride drop-offs or ordinary park-and-ride parking. TransLink priority spaces require at least two occupants and have time/payment conditions; no availability or ride-matching is provided.

Four source carpool points have descriptive nearby-road labels, not verified official lot names or civic addresses. The nearest-address geocoder is context only. Current hours, rules and continued operation of these community-tagged points are unverified.

Official contextual additions retain their source-review dates; refreshing OSM does not recheck TransLink program terms or the public-gallery selection. TransLink pages disagree on exact carpool-space counts, which are intentionally omitted.
Geometry is the source point or bounding-box centre. Direct distances and Google Maps links do not imply verified entrances, walking access or legal parking.
refresh_policy: One bounded download; no automatic retries. Partial responses, wrong query, missing timestamps, and anomalous counts fail before published files change.
